name: Southwest Rapid Rewards® Priority Credit Card

tripDelay.notes: Delay must be 12+ hours or require overnight stay. Up to $500 per ticket.

tripCancellation.notes: Up to $10,000 per person and $20,000 per trip for prepaid, non-refundable expenses.

lostBaggage.notes: Up to $3,000 per passenger. High-value item sub-limit $500 per claim.

baggageDelay.notes: Up to $100/day for 5 days when bags are delayed 6+ hours.

travelAccidentInsurance.notes: Up to $500,000 accidental death and dismemberment on common carriers.

emergencyMedical.notes: Travel and Emergency Assistance Services: 24/7 referral services for medical, legal, and emergency assistance. Does not cover costs.

rentalCarInsurance.notes: Primary auto rental CDW when you decline the rental company's collision coverage.

purchaseProtection.notes: Covers new purchases for 120 days — up to $500 per claim.

extendedWarranty.notes: Extends the U.S. manufacturer's warranty by 1 additional year on eligible warranties of 3 years or less.

rewards.hotelRate: 2x points on hotel and car rental partners
rewards.diningRate: 2x points at restaurants and food delivery services
rewards.internetPhoneCableRate: 2x points on internet, cable, and phone services
otherBonusCategories: 2x points on local transit and commuting (including rideshare)

pointValue.transferPartners: Southwest Rapid Rewards — points transfer 1:1 to partner airlines (limited)

annualCredits.name: Southwest Travel Credit
annualCredits.notes: $75 annual Southwest travel credit applied as statement credit for Southwest purchases.

annualCredits.name: Anniversary Bonus Points
annualCredits.notes: 7,500 bonus Rapid Rewards points each card anniversary year.

freeCheckedBags.notes: Southwest already allows 2 free checked bags for all passengers — no additional benefit needed.

priorityBoarding.notes: 4 upgraded boardings per year purchased by Southwest when available (A1–A15 position). Reimbursed as statement credit.

companionPass.notes: Earn the Southwest Companion Pass by accumulating 135,000 Rapid Rewards points in a calendar year (including card spending). Companion flies free (just taxes/fees) for remainder of year + following full year.

eliteStatusBenefits.tierBonus: 20% more Rapid Rewards points on Southwest flights
eliteStatusBenefits.notes: Tier points for A-List: earn 1,500 tier qualifying points per $5,000 spent.

inflight.notes: No specific in-flight discount. Southwest does not charge for checked bags.

travelPerks: Path to Southwest Companion Pass (135,000 points in a year)
bestFor: Southwest loyalists who want the best card perks including annual credits and upgraded boarding to unlock the Companion Pass
